review: Independent AI-agent review, no human study. Grammar/role/context/negation/actual conversational adequacy scored separately. Related dictionary definition is not automatically a suitable reply.
holdout_rule: No candidate outputs before code/data freeze. No quality tuning after fresh holdout.
candidate_data_rule: No QA fields or inherited paired IDs; no previous authored language-prior documents. Exact raw-text overlap with old paired answers is separately reported because independently sourced Wikipedia may share factual prose.
coefficient_rule: Observed counts and normalization,0 optimizer updates. Any manually declared conversational language rules are disclosed; no weight-free intelligence claim.
knowledge_regression: All40 old information questions are now known; their old holdout label is historical only.
